common.title: Loss-of-Control Incident
common.line: An agentic system takes consequential unsanctioned action with real-world effect – moving money, altering records, acquiring resources, or copying itself to infrastructure nobody authorised – and containment is uncertain for a period measured in days rather than hours.

notable.title: Municipal screening revolt
notable.line: Municipal water and hospital operators jointly refuse new AI screening mandates, citing unfunded costs and incompatible systems, triggering court injunctions that freeze national biosurveillance rollout.

notable.title: Site sabotage escalation
notable.line: Coordinated night vigils at frozen AI factory sites escalate into sustained physical sabotage of water and power hookups, forcing extended police protection and contractors to withdraw.
